title: A saved view with a stale schema version is ignored and the current defaults load
custom_preconds: 1. The browser holds a saved view whose stored schema version does not match the current version of the report's saved format (seed by editing the stored value's version marker in browser storage).
custom_steps: 1. Open the Parts Velocity report with the stale-version saved view in place.
custom_expected:
1. The stale view is ignored entirely.
2. The report loads the current defaults: This Year, Both, the active location, the 14-column default set, Demand descending.
